title: Registered marks and seizure
rule: Timber moved from a forest area must have a transit pass and the registered mark. An authorised officer may seize produce that has no registered mark or whose mark has been defaced or sawn off.
points: The Director and local authorities give authorised officers distinctive registered marks. The officer is responsible for the mark and hands it in on leaving office.
Licence holders register a property mark with the Director.
Only the registered owner may use a registered mark. Using unregistered, defaced or counterfeit marks is an offence under the Regulations.
